Because that statement is a trust-1 session remark rather than a typed decision, the paragraph says it isn't a confirmed standing policy and should be confirmed before anyone relies on it.

This is a Go repo (gin), and tokio is a Rust runtime, so the recorded value may not apply to this project in practice.
